# Core Complex RTL Files

## Design Top

Top module: `core_complex_top.v`

### File suffix overview:

* `*_top.v`: top Verilog module
* `*_wrapper.vhd`: VHDL wrapper to configure RISC-V core generics
* `*.autogenerated.v`: auto-generated Verilog file (from VHDL by GHDL)

## File Management

File-list files (`*.f`) are used. Note that these list also represent the
design hierarchy and thus, define the recommended compile order (if required
at all).

* `*.v.f` - Verilog sources
* `*.vhd.f` - VHDL sources (added to specific/core library!)
